title: The priest at the Vale of Ash chapel says 'There are five more hollows in the Reach' right after Herald Corvane had explicitly listed six ('Fenmarch's drowned nave. Thornwold's hanged company. The Iron Downs' collapsed mine. Wardmoor's own founding. The Saltkerns' lost fleet. Hollowbrook's barrow-fields. Six.'). Minor but noticeable numeric mismatch between two NPCs describing the same world state moments apart.
where: Gray Chapel (gray priest) vs. Last Light Square (Herald Corvane), same play session
